weeks.content:
Honesty, kindness, hard work
Pick my top value

Great leaders serve
Act a serving leader

Same inside and outside
Do right when nobody watches

Every work has dignity
Greet and thank all workers

Love Nigeria, keep her clean
Say the pledge with meaning

Care for school property
Care for the earth

My choice, my responsibility
Say no with respect

Choose good programmes
Tell adults what troubles me

Thank my teachers and parents
Write a thank you card

Present my values ladder
Graduation character awards
